components.title: Timetable slots
components.desc: Visible on the timetable and assignments. Grades remain on « {parent} ». One teacher for the whole group.
components.empty: No slots — the course remains a single row on the timetable.

schedule.selectClass: Select a class in the left panel to view the timetable.
schedule.yearReadOnlyDesc: Your courses / slots for the entire active school year — read only.
schedule.teacherViewDesc: View your slots in this class (Monday to Saturday).
schedule.editorDesc: Plan the weekly timetable (Monday to Saturday) in a single grid
schedule.parentYearReadOnlyDesc: Annual timetable for each linked {studentLabel} — read only.
schedule.planningAdminOnly: Slot planning is reserved for administration.
schedule.clickEmptyCell: Click an empty cell to place a course (Monday to Saturday).
schedule.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# conflict detected in the timetable} other {# conflicts detected in the timetable}}
schedule.conflictsHint: Affected courses are shown together and will be flagged in the PDF.
schedule.noVacationTitle: No time slot assigned to this class
schedule.noVacationDesc: Configure the day structure (periods and break) then assign a time slot to the class.
schedule.emptyEditable: No courses scheduled. Click a cell to get started.
schedule.emptyReadOnly: No timetable available for this class.
schedule.noAssignedCourses: No course assigned to this class. Add a teacher assignment first.
schedule.generateCompleteRetry: Complete timetable found after {attempts} attempts ({placed} session(s)).
schedule.generatePartial: Best attempt after {attempts} tries: {placed} session(s). {failures} incomplete course(s) (teachers already booked elsewhere or time slot full). Regenerate to retry.
schedule.confirmGenerateDesc: Automatically generated (AUTO) sessions for this class will be replaced by a new random layout based on minutes / week and the time slot. Manual placements are kept. Each teacher's availability is respected across other classes, cycles and branches in the organization.
schedule.confirmGenerateHint: If a proposal blocks courses, the system automatically tries other layouts (up to ~50 attempts) to free a slot while avoiding teacher conflicts (other classes, cycles and branches). You can regenerate manually for another variant.
schedule.deleteCourseDesc: This action is permanent. You can then place another course in this cell.
schedule.clearSuccess: {count, plural, one {# slot removed.} other {# slots removed.}}
schedule.confirmClearDesc: All slots for this class (manual and generated) will be deleted. Teacher assignments are kept.
schedule.reconduireDesc: Copies only courses, days and hours from another class. Slots are placed with teachers already assigned to this class, to avoid overlaps.
schedule.reconduireEmpty: No other class with a timetable
schedule.reconduireReloadError: Timetable copied, but reload failed. Refresh the page.
schedule.reconduireNothingPlaced: No slot placed ({occupied} already occupied, {conflicts} conflict(s), {unassigned} course(s) with no teacher here).
schedule.reconduireSkipped: {occupied} occupied cell(s) skipped. {conflicts} teacher conflict(s) skipped. {unassigned} course(s) with no teacher in this class skipped.
